product_updates.title: After killer quarter, Palantir CEO Alex Karp calls AI industry ‘Marxist’
product_updates.content: After a quarter that delivered $1 billion in profit, Palantir CEO Alex Karp on Monday once again warned that AI frontier labs are too untrustworthy for enterprises.

product_updates.title: AWS is helping vibe-coding startup Superblocks, and the implications are big
product_updates.content: AWS now allows vibe-coding tool Superblocks to be embedded into the private clouds of AWS customers. It's another step toward decoupling apps from models.

product_updates.title: Design Arena creators raise $7.9 million to bring taste to AI models
product_updates.content: Design Arena is used by 5.3 million people around the world, providing critical human evaluations to frontier labs.

product_updates.title: Influencers draw backlash for attending OpenAI’s first luxury trip
product_updates.content: OpenAI’s first-ever influencer brand trip is sparking online backlash as tensions over the use of AI continue.

product_updates.title: Apple finally fixed Siri. So why does it feel anticlimactic?
product_updates.content: Apple’s long-awaited AI overhaul finally makes Siri the assistant it was always supposed to be. Yet it arrives at a moment when simply being a capable AI assistant no longer feels revolutionary.

product_updates.title: Congress’ favorite AI tool? ChatGPT
product_updates.content: House spending records show OpenAI's ChatGPT dominates paid AI use on Capitol Hill, with congressional offices relying on the chatbot to draft memos, summarize legislation, and assist constituent communications.

product_updates.title: A Marc Benioff-backed startup thinks AI can solve the AI deployment problem
product_updates.content: June emerged from stealth today with a $20 million pre-seed round to make AI adoption simpler.
